radius.title: Attraction radius
radius.description: Pointer distance where the card starts responding, in pixels.

travel.title: Travel
travel.description: Maximum translation toward the pointer, in pixels.

depthPx.title: Layer depth
depthPx.description: Separation between card layers, in pixels.

perspectivePx.title: Perspective
perspectivePx.description: CSS perspective distance in pixels; smaller values increase depth.

glow.title: Glow
glow.description: Highlight strength from zero to one.

reducedMotion.title: Reduced motion
reducedMotion.description: Keep content and focus behavior while disabling pointer movement.
